text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَٰفِرُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive and coordinating connector that opens the reported denial while linking it to the prior creation-and-gratitude sequence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the attached speech verb that begins the reported denial

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add another clause. It carries the prior charge of little gratitude into a new quoted speech unit, then clings to {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}) so the reported denial is heard as the concrete display of that failure. The word is therefore a boundary marker: continuous with 32:9, but opening a fresh speech scene.

topics.headline: resumptive connector opens the speech report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is not isolated; it is introduced as the next scene after the prior creation-and-gratitude charge.
topics.reason: The local clause analysis marks {{ar:وَقَالُوا}} ({{tr:wa-qālū}}) as introducing quoted speech, while the discourse boundary links it back to 32:9.

topics.headline: visible attachment binds connector to speech verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boundary relation is attached directly to the speech verb instead of standing as a detached transition.
topics.reason: The proclitic conjunction is part of the visible-recited cluster with {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}), supporting a small form-level payoff.

words.gloss_range: reported collective speech-act: they said, claimed, or voiced a position, here launching a quoted denial frame
words.root_gloss_range: saying, declaring, asserting, and formulating a claim; local grammar selects voiced report rather than mere inner thought
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا}} ({{tr:qālū}}) makes disbelief audible as a collective speech-act. The perfect plural presents the objection as a stance already taken by the group, and the quoted span that follows lets them state the impossibility frame in their own words. The wording belongs to a recurring resurrection-denial voice, with material-decay parallels in 36:78, 56:47, and 17:49. Because 32:11 answers with command speech, the human saying here becomes the occasion for a directed response.

topics.headline: perfect plural reports a settled group claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the objection is a collective stance presented as already voiced, not a private doubt still being explored.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form I perfect 3mp verb, and attachment evidence supplies the implicit plural subject as the objecting group.

topics.headline: speech verb launches the direct denial quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first stages the deniers' own rhetoric before correcting it.
topics.reason: The quoted complement is syntactically forced from {{ar:أَإِذَا}} ({{tr:a-idhā}}) through {{ar:جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:jadīdin}}).

topics.headline: reported saying belongs to a denial formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is a recognizable resurrection-denial voice, echoed in material-decay objections such as 36:78, 56:47, and 17:49.
topics.reason: The cross-ayah rows give concrete parallels and the local wording contains the same quoted new-creation challenge.

topics.headline: their saying bridges prior gifts and later command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech-act both misuses the faculties just mentioned and sets up the commanded answer in 32:11.
topics.reason: Boundary profiles connect the reported group from the prior address to the following imperative response.

words.gloss_range: interrogative hamza plus temporal condition, opening an incredulous when-frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the second interrogative that completes the paired denial question

words.prose: {{ar:أَإِذَا}} ({{tr:a-idhā}}) makes time itself the first pressure point in the objection: when we have become lost in the earth, then what? The hamza turns a future condition into incredulous challenge, while the conditional syntax forces the reader to carry the decay scenario forward into the second question. Variant pressure can soften or omit the first hamza, but the canonical local frame still stages disbelief through the paired question with {{ar:أَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:a-innā}}).

topics.headline: interrogative condition opens the impossibility frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers challenge the timing after dissolution before they challenge re-creation itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:أَإِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:a-idhā ḍalalnā fī l-arḍi}}) as the conditional protasis for the following interrogative assertion.

topics.headline: paired hamzas turn question into denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording asks in order to deny, not to request information.
topics.reason: The local construction pairs this first interrogative with {{ar:أَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:a-innā}}), and the correction after {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) confirms denial force.

topics.headline: variant hamza handling shows the question feature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hamza is the feature that makes the temporal condition sound openly incredulous, even where accepted recitation eases the articulation.
topics.reason: Variant rows illuminate the interrogative feature but do not replace the canonical local analysis.

words.gloss_range: we became lost, vanished, or dispersed; locally physical loss in earth, with moral misguidance shadowing the final verdict
words.root_gloss_range: straying, losing the way, disappearing, vanishing, and being caused to go astray; local form selects intransitive self-involved loss under the earth-locative

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: locative phrase selecting physical disappearance in the earth
first-person plural suffix making the loss self-referential

words.prose: {{ar:ضَلَلْنَا}} ({{tr:ḍalalnā}}) puts the speakers inside their own decay scenario: when we have become lost in the earth. The locative phrase selects physical disappearance or dispersal, but the root still shadows moral straying, so the final verdict of denial turns their material argument back toward their own condition. The loss is posed as the obstacle to new creation and anticipates the later guidance-withholding field in 32:13. Form I and the suffix {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) keep the loss self-involved; passive or desiccation variants remain contrastive, not the governing local parse. The heavy emphatic opening and repeated lateral sound make the disappearance word feel weighted in recitation.

topics.headline: the speakers picture their own completed loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the objection is personal and vivid: the speakers imagine themselves already dissolved in the future condition.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect 1cp under the temporal condition, with the speakers supplied by the agreement and carried into {{ar:أَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:a-innā}}).

topics.headline: earth-locative selects physical loss while moral straying echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers' physical disappearance claim is phrased with a root that also shadows the moral lostness diagnosed later.
topics.reason: {{ar:فِي الْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:fī l-arḍi}}) narrows the local sense to physical loss, while the root range and final denial predicate preserve the moral echo.

topics.headline: simple intransitive form excludes variant control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local form presents them as undergoing loss without naming an external causer, while variant readings expose nearby alternate construals.
topics.reason: The canonical surface is Form I active 1cp; passive causation and desiccation are useful apparatus contrasts but do not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: loss is posed against new creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that physical loss is framed as the stated obstacle to new creation and also anticipates the surah's later guidance-withholding field in 32:13.
topics.reason: The local syntax sets loss before {{ar:خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin jadīdin}}), and the cited surah-local rows give a concrete later reference.

topics.headline: sound shape weighs down the loss word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a heavy emphatic opening and repeated lateral sound in the word that names disappearance.
topics.reason: The phonetic and rarity rows support a modest surface-level payoff without changing the selected sense.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition marking containment within the earth

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the later creation noun that becomes the second containment phrase

words.prose: The first {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) fixes the loss as spatial containment: the speakers imagine themselves inside the earth, not merely gone from view. Because the same preposition returns before {{ar:خَلْقٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}), the ayah sets up a sharp reversal from being in the earth to being in a new creation-state.

topics.headline: preposition makes loss spatially contained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the objection depends on being contained and dispersed in the earth as a physical location.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:الْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) as the prepositional complement governed by this {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}).

topics.headline: first containment prepares the second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated preposition turning from earth-container to creation-state.
topics.reason: The ayah contains two local {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) phrases with different complements and rhetorical roles.

words.gloss_range: the earth as familiar material substrate and grave-like dissolution medium
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, and lower material domain; local phrase selects the substrate into which bodies are imagined to disappear

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the loss verb before the earth phrase
the new-creation phrase after the earth phrase

words.prose: {{ar:الْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is the familiar earth, but here it is narrowed to the material substrate in which the speakers imagine bodies dispersed. Its definiteness and singular form universalize the ground as the obvious grave-medium. Sitting between {{ar:ضَلَلْنَا}} ({{tr:ḍalalnā}}) and {{ar:خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin jadīdin}}), the word becomes the pivot between dissolution and the denied re-creation. The same earth also belongs to the surah's broader creation and lordship domain, so the supposed burial-medium is still inside the field of divine sovereignty.

topics.headline: familiar earth becomes dissolution substrate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the objection relies on the visible, familiar earth as the medium that supposedly makes bodies irrecoverable.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive under {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}), and locally tied to the loss verb as its locative complement.

topics.headline: earth mediates loss and new creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is not background scenery; it stands between the claimed dissolution and the challenged new creation.
topics.reason: Local word order places {{ar:الْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) between the loss clause and the new-creation phrase, and the root pairing with creation is contextually attested.

topics.headline: earth belongs to the surah's domain of signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth invoked as burial-medium is also part of the broader domain over which lordship and creation are displayed.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles connect earth with creation, signs, and lordship across the surah without changing the local locative function.

words.gloss_range: interrogative hamza plus emphatic particle and first-person plural pronoun, forming an incredulous assertion-question

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the emphatic particle inside the compound question
the first-person plural pronoun inside the compound question
the emphatic predicate phrase governed by the question

words.prose: {{ar:أَإِنَّا}} ({{tr:a-innā}}) completes the double-question structure. The form stacks interrogation, {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) assertion, and the pronoun {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}), so the speakers phrase denial as an emphatic "are we really...?" The second hamza mirrors the first question's arrest point but concentrates disbelief on the reality of re-creation. The grammar is assertive in shape but disbelieving in use, and the predicate that follows is held under its scope.

topics.headline: assertive grammar becomes incredulous question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tension between emphatic assertion grammar and the speakers' refusal to accept the asserted state.
topics.reason: QAC marks the compound as interrogative hamza plus emphatic particle and pronoun, and local translation support requires preserving interrogative force.

topics.headline: inna governs the new-creation predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole {{ar:لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:la-fī khalqin jadīdin}}) phrase sits inside the emphatic-question frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence parses {{ar:لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:la-fī khalqin jadīdin}}) as the predicate of the {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) clause.

topics.headline: second hamza parallels the first without erasing local force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second arrest point mirrors the first question while concentrating disbelief on the reality of re-creation.
topics.reason: Hamza variants and phonetic rows support the interrogative pressure, but the canonical local parse remains the governing form.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lam prefixed to the predicate of inna, repurposed inside an incredulous question

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the new-creation content delayed by the emphatic predicate markers

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is affirmation pressed into a skeptical question. It strengthens the predicate phrase before the content is named, so the utterance sounds like emphatic incredulity: are we indeed in a new creation? The short particle also helps delay the object of denial until {{ar:خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin jadīdin}}) arrives.

topics.headline: affirming lam intensifies incredulity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers borrow emphatic assertion form to make disbelief sound stronger.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as emphatic lam on the predicate of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), and local force is interrogative.

topics.headline: stacked emphasis delays the denied content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the predicate is loaded with markers before the phrase naming new creation appears.
topics.reason: The local sequence places {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) before {{ar:فِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:fī khalqin jadīdin}}), narrowing the denied state under the emphatic predicate.

words.gloss_range: predicate preposition marking being in a new creation-state under emphatic interrogative scope

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the new-creation state governed by the second preposition
the interrogative and emphatic frame governing this preposition

words.prose: The second {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) changes containment into existential state. The first {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) placed them in the earth; this one places them, incredulously, in {{ar:خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin jadīdin}}). Because it falls under {{ar:أَإِنَّا لَ}} ({{tr:a-innā la}}), the preposition carries the exact state the speakers refuse.

topics.headline: preposition marks the denied state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that re-creation is phrased as being inside a new state, not merely receiving a label.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:خَلْقٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}) as governed by this {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) in the predicate phrase.

topics.headline: repeated fī reverses the container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rhetorical turn from being in earth to being in new creation.
topics.reason: The two local prepositional phrases share {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) but differ in complement and rhetorical direction.

words.gloss_range: creation, making, or reconstitution as an indefinite verbal noun; locally the denied event-state of new creation
words.root_gloss_range: creating, shaping, making, determining, and in some branches fabricating; local phrase selects creation/re-creation rather than false fabrication

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: qualitative adjective agreeing with and narrowing the creation noun

words.prose: {{ar:خَلْقٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}) is the object-state the speakers resist: a creation or reconstitution after dissolution. Its maṣdar form foregrounds the event of creating, and its indefiniteness leaves the imagined reconstitution open rather than neatly specified. The wider root can include fabricating, but local grammar and the resurrection-denial formula narrow the active sense to creation/remaking, especially with {{ar:جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:jadīdin}}) attached. The same new-creation challenge recurs in 17:49, 17:98, and 34:7, while this surah turns prior divine making into a disputed remaking claim inside the quote.

topics.headline: indefinite maṣdar names an open creation-event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied reality is an unspecified event-state of creation, not a fully described object.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:خَلْقٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}) as a genitive gerund governed by {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}), and the tanwīn keeps it indefinite.

topics.headline: root range narrows to re-creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root's making range, while the local resurrection frame keeps fabrication or wear-out branches from governing the phrase.
topics.reason: The adjective {{ar:جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:jadīdin}}) and the quoted resurrection challenge select creation/reconstitution; broader branches remain lexical background.

topics.headline: khalq jadīd is a resurrection-denial formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase belongs to recurring objections to re-creation, including 17:49, 17:98, and 34:7.
topics.reason: The concrete parallel rows name repeated new-creation denial passages and the local phrase matches the formula.

topics.headline: disputed remaking answers prior creation context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the creation root returns from divine making in the surrounding surah into a disputed remaking claim inside the quote.
topics.reason: The local quoted challenge follows earlier creation material in the surah and binds rhythmically with {{ar:جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:jadīdin}}).

words.gloss_range: new, renewed, fresh, or unprecedented; locally an indefinite qualitative adjective modifying creation
words.root_gloss_range: newness, renewal, freshness, severance or distinctness in some branches; local adjective selects new/renewed creation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the creation noun qualified by the adjective

words.prose: {{ar:جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:jadīdin}}) locks the objection onto newness. It agrees with {{ar:خَلْقٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}) and remains indefinite, so the speakers do not deny a named instance but the very prospect of a new or renewed creation. The root's renewal pressure matters, but the local adjective, not a renewal verb, is what completes the quoted formula. In denial contexts, the contested word is precisely "new," and the matching -in cadence with {{ar:خَلْقٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}) lets the phrase close as one compact formula.

topics.headline: adjective binds newness to creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that newness is not free-floating; it grammatically qualifies the creation-event the speakers deny.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:jadīdin}}) as the agreeing adjective of {{ar:خَلْقٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}).

topics.headline: renewed and unprecedented newness converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the adjective can carry renewal pressure as well as sheer novelty, while local grammar keeps it adjectival.
topics.reason: The root family supports renewal language, but the surface is a qualitative adjective modifying creation rather than a finite renewal action.

topics.headline: new completes the denial formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted challenge lands on the impossible qualifier, matching other denial contexts where "new" is the contested word.
topics.reason: The word completes the local {{ar:خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ}} ({{tr:khalqin jadīdin}}) formula and shares its indefinite cadence with the noun.

words.gloss_range: adversative corrective particle that retracts the quoted frame and pivots to divine diagnosis

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the third-person pronoun that follows the corrective pivot

words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) does not answer the quoted question on its own premise. It breaks the frame and replaces it: the issue is not whether earth can block re-creation, but that they are deniers of meeting their Lord. Its short, independent form marks the pivot from quotation to assessment, and the following {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) makes the shift from quoted first-person speech to distanced third-person verdict visible.

topics.headline: bal overwrites the objection's premise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah shifts from answering material impossibility to diagnosing denial of encounter.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ}} ({{tr:bal hum bi-liqāʾi rabbihim kāfirūna}}) as the corrective nominal clause after the quote.

topics.headline: short particle divides quotation and verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's architecture: reported question first, then abrupt corrective verdict.
topics.reason: The particle stands at the boundary between the quoted clause and the following nominal diagnosis.

topics.headline: pivot creates distance from the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the shift from the speakers' first-person quote to a distanced third-person assessment.
topics.reason: The correction is followed immediately by {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}), changing the perspective from quoted "we" to evaluated "they".

words.gloss_range: independent third-person plural pronoun, explicit subject of the corrective nominal clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first-person plural suffix from the quoted self-reference
the corrective particle before the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) isolates the speakers after the corrective pivot. Inside the quote they spoke as {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}), "we"; after {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) they become a third-person group placed before the verdict. The explicit pronoun makes the class of deniers stand in view before the predicate arrives.

topics.headline: independent pronoun isolates the deniers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the corrective clause first displays the group itself before naming their denial.
topics.reason: QAC marks an independent pronoun, and attachment evidence parses {{ar:كَافِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}) as its predicate.

topics.headline: quoted we becomes assessed they
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the perspective shift from their self-framing to divine assessment of them.
topics.reason: The referent profiles connect {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) to the same objecting group who spoke with first-person plural forms.

topics.headline: pronoun creates distance from the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressed or self-speaking group is reclassified from outside their own claim.
topics.reason: The nominal clause after {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) resumes the group as third person and prepares the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the domain or object of disbelief: concerning or with respect to the encounter

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the meeting-with-their-Lord phrase governed by the preposition
the final denial predicate delayed after the prepositional phrase

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) scopes the final verdict. They are not described here as deniers in the abstract; the preposition attaches their denial to {{ar:لِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:liqāʾi rabbihim}}), the meeting with their Lord. By fronting this prepositional phrase before {{ar:كَافِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}), the ayah delays the verdict until the denied object has been named.

topics.headline: bi scopes disbelief to the encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is targeted at the meeting-event, not left as a vague accusation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:لِقَاءِ}} ({{tr:liqāʾi}}) as governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and linked to the final predicate.

topics.headline: fronted bi-phrase delays the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of denial is heard before the final label lands.
topics.reason: The preposition is visibly prefixed to the encounter noun and the whole phrase precedes {{ar:كَافِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}).

words.gloss_range: meeting, encounter, or contact-event; locally the eschatological encounter with their Lord as the object-domain of denial
words.root_gloss_range: meeting, encountering, receiving, casting, and contact; local maṣdar construct selects the event of encounter while leaving roles open within the construct

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct complement that makes the meeting relational

words.prose: {{ar:لِقَاءِ}} ({{tr:liqāʾi}}) names the denied reality as an encounter-event, not a bare doctrine. As a maṣdar in construct with {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}), it keeps the meeting relational and lets the concrete contact image press into the eschatological frame. Because it is governed by the denial phrase, the prospect being covered over is the encounter itself. The same encounter formula can carry hope or loss elsewhere, including 18:110, but here it is the object of denial and returns later as an unavoidable meeting motif in 32:14 and 32:23.

topics.headline: maṣdar construct makes meeting relational
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied object is an encounter-event bound to their Lord, with agency left grammatically open.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:لِقَاءِ}} ({{tr:liqāʾi}}) as a gerund, and attachment evidence marks {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) as its construct complement.

topics.headline: contact root gives encounter weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices concrete contact and possible confrontation pressure behind the eschatological meeting, while the local phrase keeps meeting as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root range supports receiving, casting, contact, and encounter, but local construct syntax and eschatological context select the meeting-event.

topics.headline: encounter is paired with denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict targets the encounter itself: they cover over or deny the prospect of meeting their Lord.
topics.reason: The preposition {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) connects the encounter noun to {{ar:كَافِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}), making it the domain of denial.

topics.headline: meeting formula shifts by context and returns locally

topics.reason: The rows supply concrete cross-references such as 6:31, 10:45, and 18:110, plus later local returns in 32:14 and 32:23.

words.gloss_range: their Lord, master, sustainer, and nurturer; locally the construct complement that completes the denied meeting
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, ownership, sustaining, rearing, and nurturing; local phrase names the one to whom the deniers remain related
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) completes the encounter phrase and keeps relationship in force even in denial. The suffix says "their" Lord, so the ayah does not let them deny the meeting while becoming unrelated to the one who sustains them. The singular construct presents one Lord for the whole group, and the wider lordship-and-nurture field ties this denied encounter back to the creation and gifting already described in 32:7-9. The title also belongs to the surah-local lordship thread that carries the denied meeting toward 32:14.

topics.headline: their Lord completes the meeting construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied meeting remains grammatically bound to their own Lord, not to an abstract deity label.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:rabbihim}}) as genitive construct complement of {{ar:لِقَاءِ}} ({{tr:liqāʾi}}), with suffix referring back to the deniers.

topics.headline: lordship includes sustaining nurture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied encounter is with the one who sustains and nurtures them, not a distant or generic power.
topics.reason: The V4 root range supports lordship, ownership, sustaining, and nurturing branches coherent with the local title.

topics.headline: one Lord is related to the whole denying group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one singular Lord bound to a plural group, making the relation collective without making lordship plural.
topics.reason: The word is singular construct with a 3mp suffix and follows the new-creation phrase within the same correction.

topics.headline: rabb links creation, gifts, and judgment scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title belongs to a surah-local lordship thread, linking prior creation and gifting to later meeting language in 32:14.
topics.reason: The critical rows supply surah-local links from 32:7-9 into 32:10 and forward to 32:14.

words.gloss_range: deniers, disbelievers, or coverers; locally a nominative plural active-participle predicate classifying the group by denial of the meeting
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denying, disbelieving, and ingratitude; local verdict selects denial while the covering image reverses the earth-loss claim
words.prose: {{ar:كَافِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}) is the ayah's final verdict. As a nominative plural active participle, it classifies the group with an enduring predicate rather than reporting one past act. The root's covering image answers their earth-image: they claim bodies are covered and lost in the earth, but the ayah says they are the coverers of the meeting with their Lord. The final position makes that diagnosis, not the phrase "new creation," the closing takeaway, converting what they said into what they are. It also links back to the absence of gratitude in 32:9 and forward to the meeting-language outcome in 32:14.

topics.headline: active participle predicates enduring denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause classifies them as deniers, not merely as people who once denied.
topics.reason: QAC marks an active participle, and attachment evidence parses it as the predicate of {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}).

topics.headline: plural predicate classifies the whole group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is collective and classificatory, matching the plural speakers of the quotation.
topics.reason: The sound masculine plural ending and nominative case complete the nominal predicate for the resumed group.

topics.headline: covering image reverses the burial argument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony: those who claim earth covers bodies are themselves named as coverers of the encounter.
topics.reason: The root's covering branch is coherent with the local earth-loss imagery and the final denial predicate.

topics.headline: denial is scoped to meeting their Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moral verdict is specifically about covering or denying the meeting with their Lord.
topics.reason: {{ar:بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ}} ({{tr:bi-liqāʾi rabbihim}}) is the prepositional complement tied to the denial predicate.

topics.headline: final word closes the quote as diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes by converting what they said into what they are.
topics.reason: The ayah opens with speech and ends with the predicate verdict, and the rows connect this denial to the truth declared in 32:3.

topics.headline: kufr tracks later judgment and prior ingratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final denial links backward to absent gratitude and forward to the meeting-language outcome in 32:14.
topics.reason: The boundary and surah-local rows connect 32:9, the current final predicate, and later meeting/judgment language.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 3-9: disappearance in earth followed by the question of new creation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers convert concealment and lost locatability into nonbeing. The adjacent creation and newness roots instead leave a mechanism of measured re-origination after material disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Its image of something hidden within another medium makes disappearance a failure of access before it is proof of nonbeing.
Its lost-object image supplies the speakers' move from unlocatable material to allegedly unrecoverable identity.
The lower domain functions as the receiving medium in which the body is imagined to vanish.
Prior measuring and proportioning supplies a determination by which dispersed material can be reconstituted.
Origination from material keeps a second origination conceptually available after earthly dispersal.
New occurrence after a break turns the alleged terminal loss into an interval before renewal.

changed_reading.before: They deny resurrection because the body is destroyed in soil.
changed_reading.after: They mistake being hidden and unlocatable within earth for annihilation, although measured re-origination remains encoded beside the claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The corrective bal-clause, especially meeting, Lord, and covering at words 12-14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The correction shifts the center from material mechanics to a refused encounter: two parties can face one another because the Lord tends and completes what belongs to him, while covering blocks acknowledgment of that relation.

activation_trace.role: The convergence of two facing parties makes resurrection an encounter rather than merely the production of another body.
Progressive tending and completion supplies continuity between the dispersed creature and the one brought to encounter.
Covering makes the final predicate an active concealment of the encounter rather than a neutral inference from decay.
Blocking acknowledged truth gives the bal-clause its diagnostic force: the material objection protects a deeper refusal.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause simply labels the speakers unbelievers after their physical objection.
changed_reading.after: The closing correction exposes the physical objection as a screen over accountable re-encounter with the one who has continuously tended them.

baseline_models.mechanism: The two adjacent roots permit a workshop-like sequence: estimate, sever, then renew. A worn-material branch keeps the analogy tied to remaking after deterioration rather than replacement without continuity.

activation_trace.role: Measurement before cutting supplies the first operation in a controlled remaking sequence.
Cutting and severance lets earthly disaggregation become an operation within renewal rather than its defeat.
Fresh occurrence after severance completes the sequence from division to renewed form.
The image of fabric worn by use supplies a material analogy for a form that deteriorates yet can be remade.

changed_reading.before: New creation means an unrelated replacement after the old body is gone.
changed_reading.after: New creation can be heard as controlled remeasurement and renewal through the very severance and wear that the speakers treat as disproof.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening speech verb and the final covering predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech can externalize an inward belief or operate as a proposition under uncertainty. Here the question is not only information-seeking; it performs a settled position that turns invisibility into impossibility and shields the speaker from meeting.

activation_trace.role: Speech operating like supposition gives the interrogative an epistemic stance, not merely quoted words.
Speech as belief or doctrine makes the utterance a declared worldview about what counts as possible.
Denial supplies the protective function of the stated worldview against the meeting it excludes.
The facing encounter identifies what the speech-position avoids rather than what it neutrally investigates.

changed_reading.before: The speakers voice a spontaneous puzzle about bodily continuity.
changed_reading.after: Their interrogative is also a public theory of impossibility whose function is to keep the impending encounter out of view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier accusation that the message was fabricated, followed by a correction to truth, recurs structurally in the focus utterance and correction. The fabrication branch of creation therefore becomes a live undertone in how the speakers voice 'new creation': they may be presenting it as an invented claim, not neutrally naming a possibility.

activation_trace.role: Attributing speech as made up supplies the recurring polemical use of saying.
Explicit fabrication gives the earlier accusation its mechanism and activates the same possibility around the focus phrase.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the corrective pole opposite the accusation.
The branch of contrived speech lets 'creation' carry the speakers' possible insinuation without replacing its ordinary creation sense.
Speech as a held position anchors the activated insinuation in the focus utterance.

structural_cues: 32:3 and 32:10 both place a 'they say' claim before a bal-correction concerning a divine assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated accusation/correction pattern and the fabrication branch; I infer that the earlier polemical posture colors the later phrase. A live alternative is simple speaker continuity with no semantic coloring of 'creation.'

changed_reading.before: The phrase 'new creation' neutrally states the proposition they doubt.
changed_reading.after: Within the repeated discourse pattern, their wording may itself insinuate that renewed creation is a fabricated story, making the question rhetorically loaded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth is already one station in an administered descent-and-ascent whose duration is measured, and hidden reality is paired with witnessed reality under knowledge. Bodily disappearance into earth therefore shifts from an unmanaged terminal sink to an unseen leg inside a measured domain.

activation_trace.role: Managing an affair by its outcome supplies control across stages rather than abandonment at the earthly stage.
Ascent after the earthward movement makes the vertical route reversible rather than terminal.
Deliberate apportioning and foresight make the long interval governed and measured.
Being screened from eyes supplies an epistemic category for what the speakers call lost.
Presence under observation forms the visible counterpart, showing that unseen and witnessed belong to one field.
Focus concealment attaches the managed unseen circuit directly to the claimed earthly loss.

structural_cues: 32:5 moves from heaven to earth and then upward within a measured day; 32:6 immediately pairs unseen and witnessed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies administration, ascent, measure, and the unseen/witnessed pair; I infer that dispersed bodies remain inside that governable field. The live alternative is that 32:5 concerns administration generally and offers only an analogy to resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Entry into earth places the body outside any recoverable system.
changed_reading.after: Entry into earth is only the unseen segment of an already managed, reversible, and measured order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first human formation is narrated as transitions across media: clay, an extracted lineage from weak fluid, shaping, breath, and living perception. New creation now reads as another transformation in an established pipeline, with earth as a previously used substrate rather than an unprecedented obstacle.

activation_trace.role: Repeated origination in the preceding account establishes creation as an active operation across stages.
Beginning paired with return makes first origination structurally open toward repetition.
Mixed clay supplies an earthly material starting point for human formation.
Separation and slipping out supply continuity through material departure rather than static identity.
An extracted portion supplies a selective transfer mechanism from one medium into another.
Sending breath into formed material supplies the transition from shaped matter to animation.
Life-bearing spirit completes the material pipeline as embodied life.
Renewal after interruption attaches the focus question to the prior sequence of transformations.

structural_cues: 32:7-9 presents an ordered clay-to-lineage-to-shaping-to-breath sequence immediately before the objection in 32:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the staged first formation; I infer that a second formation can reuse its transition logic. The live alternative is that the sequence explains only first creation and supports resurrection by capability rather than by a shared material process.

changed_reading.before: Renewed creation would require an unprecedented replacement of matter erased by burial.
changed_reading.after: Renewed creation is the next transformation in a process that has already produced personal life from earth, extraction, weak fluid, shaping, and breath.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah answers imagined loss with complete taking: an entrusted agent receives the self, after which the addressed group returns to the same Lord. Death is recoded as custody and directed transfer, not ownerless dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Taking the self in death supplies collection as the operation that counters imagined loss.
An appointed keeper who suffices and preserves turns death into entrusted custody.
The same tending and completing Lord is the destination, preserving relational identity across death.
Return to a prior relation supplies the directed endpoint after taking.
The focus image of a lost object provides the claim that custody directly reverses.
The final facing encounter gives the custodial transfer its personal endpoint.

structural_cues: 32:11 follows the objection with an imperative answer: complete taking by a named agent, then return to a named destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies taking, an entrusted agent, and return; I infer a custody chain preserving the person through death. The live alternative is that the taking names death and agency without specifying how bodily material is preserved.

changed_reading.before: Death releases the person into ownerless matter that cannot be retrieved.
changed_reading.after: Death is a complete reception by an entrusted keeper followed by directed return, so the allegedly lost person never leaves custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: At encounter, bodily orientation is reversed, sight and hearing become effective, and return is requested; shortly afterward forgetting the meeting is answered by being left forgotten. The focus root's own loss-of-memory branch shifts the decisive loss from scattered matter to failed remembrance and recognition.

activation_trace.role: Inversion onto the head makes the future encounter a bodily reversal of the speakers' present stance.
Restored seeing supplies recognition after the earlier claim based on disappearance from view.
Hearing as understanding and compliance marks a belated epistemic correction.
The requested return reveals that identity is experienced as continuous even after the denied encounter occurs.
The repeated loss from remembrance supplies the reciprocal relational consequence around the meeting.
The same facing encounter names what was forgotten and later made unavoidable.
Loss of retention is latent in the focus verb and lets physical lostness reopen as mnemonic loss.

structural_cues: 32:12 places seeing, hearing, and a request to return before the Lord; 32:14 repeats forgetting on both sides of the forgotten meeting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory reversal, requested return, reciprocal forgetting, and the focus memory branch; I infer that relational amnesia is the deeper form of loss. The live alternative is that forgetting in 32:14 means punitive abandonment without redefining 32:10's material language.

changed_reading.before: The feared loss is that earth will erase the body's identity from retrieval.
changed_reading.after: The more consequential loss has already occurred in memory and recognition: they lose the meeting from view, then experience that chosen oblivion as reciprocal abandonment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Responsive bodies voluntarily fall earthward, later pull their sides away from places of lying, and receive what remains hidden from them. Downward bodily contact and hiddenness thus cease to be automatic signs of erasure; they can mark response, stored action, and an unrevealed outcome.

activation_trace.role: Audible, bodily falling supplies a chosen downward motion that contrasts with feared involuntary disappearance into earth.
Voluntary lowering turns earthward posture into acknowledgment rather than annihilation.
The sides' springing away from attachment supplies an answering upward separation from the bed.
A side adhering to earth supplies the resting contact from which responsive bodies detach.
A concealed recompense proves within the sequence that hiddenness need not mean absence.
The focus earth anchors this posture sequence to the domain the speakers mistake for erasure.

structural_cues: 32:15-17 moves from falling down, to leaving beds, to an outcome explicitly hidden from present knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the bodily choreography and hidden reward; I infer a contrast with burial language in 32:10. The live alternative is that these are independent worship and recompense scenes with no intended burial contrast.

changed_reading.before: Movement down toward earth and disappearance from sight jointly signify personal extinction.
changed_reading.after: Earthward movement can be a meaningful bodily response, and what is hidden after embodied action can remain preserved for disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later outcomes are containing abodes; attempted exit from one is followed by forced return, while nearer consequence aims at a prior return. New creation is therefore not bare rematerialization but placement into a consequence-bearing order where departure and return remain controlled.

activation_trace.role: Joining a gathering shelter supplies an outcome that contains persons rather than losing them.
Attempted passage outside the containing state supplies the first motion in the loop.
Return after departure closes the loop and shows continued control over location.
Return from a wrong course supplies a possible corrective movement before the final outcome.
Re-origination anchors the later containing states in the focus question of renewed existence.
What a person comes to meet as good or harm gives renewed existence its consequence-bearing content.

structural_cues: 32:19-20 gives parallel abodes, 32:20 repeats exit and return, and 32:21 assigns corrective purpose to a nearer consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abode, exit, forced return, and corrective return; I infer that renewed embodiment means controlled placement within outcomes. The live alternative is that these verses describe afterlife consequence without specifying the mechanism or meaning of re-creation.

changed_reading.before: New creation is simply a second body replacing the first.
changed_reading.after: New creation restores a person into a governed spatial and moral order in which abode, attempted departure, and return all remain consequential.

context_deltas.mechanism: The day of standing is defined by separating parties and disclosing the boundary in their divergences. Renewed creation must therefore recover differentiated persons and histories; it is a discriminating reconstitution, not an undifferentiated mass of reused matter.

activation_trace.role: Making a boundary visible between things supplies differentiation after material reassembly.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood gives differentiated reconstitution its purpose.
The interval between parties preserves plurality rather than collapsing persons into one recreated material aggregate.
Standing and resurrection explicitly locates the separating action in renewed embodied presence.
Divergent paths preserve the distinct histories that judgment must recover and resolve.
A completed, perceptible form supplies the personal differentiation required for judgment.
Renewal after interruption supplies the reconstituted presence on which separation operates.

structural_cues: 32:25 places separation between plural parties on the day of standing and ties it to their prior disagreements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection, parties, divergence, and judicial separation; I infer that renewed creation preserves person-specific histories for adjudication. The live alternative is that personal differentiation is presupposed rather than explained by the focus phrase.

changed_reading.before: Re-creation answers only whether matter can exist again.
changed_reading.after: Re-creation must restore bounded persons and their divergent histories so that judgment can distinguish rather than merely reproduce matter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Driven water enters vegetation-cut earth, crop emerges from concealment, and that crop passes by eating into livestock and human selves. The very domain imagined as a terminal sink is shown operating as a converter that hides, releases, and transfers material across living forms.

activation_trace.role: Directed driving supplies agency that moves the activating water toward apparently dead land.
Delivered water supplies the material input that reverses the land's barren state.
Earth capable of rooted growth supplies the latent productive capacity beneath the stated barrenness.
Land stripped of vegetation supplies the closest contextual image of apparent material finality.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence rather than creation from an unrelated location.
Cultivated growth supplies renewed organized life from the watered substrate.
Crop yield entering eaters supplies transfer of earth-derived material across plant, animal, and human bodies.
Disappearance within another medium anchors the ecological sequence to the focus claim of loss in earth.
Renewed occurrence names the organized emergence that the land sequence makes materially imaginable.

structural_cues: 32:27 gives an explicit input-to-output chain: water is driven to barren earth, crop comes out, and animals and selves eat from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the complete land-water-crop-consumption chain; I infer that it models human material recovery and circulation. The live alternative is that the chain is solely a provision-sign and demonstrates power without mapping a resurrection process.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant r-b-w target supplied for the focus Lord root. It remains anchored by that explicit split inventory and by 32:27's earth-to-crop sequence, but downstream prose must qualify it as a growth echo around Lordship, not replace 'Lord' with a growth meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Meeting their Lord under the packet's secondary r-b-w mapping.

activation_trace.role: Nourishing growth supplies a secondary maturation frame for continuity under the Lord's care.

strongest_changes: 32:11 changes earthly loss into complete taking, entrusted custody, and directed return.
32:14 moves the decisive loss from matter to forgotten meeting and reciprocal abandonment.
32:27 changes earth from a terminal sink into a water-activated medium of emergence and bodily material transfer.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots repeatedly cross concealment with continuity: loss can be hiddenness or failed memory, creation can be measured renewal after cutting, meeting preserves relational identity, and covering can unexpectedly evoke the buried seed. The split q-l-l and r-b-w targets add contained resonances of instability and growth without displacing the dominant readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The fabrication undertone in 'new creation' depends on carrying the repeated 32:3 accusation/correction pattern into 32:10.
The land-water-crop chain strongly supports material analogy, but its application to personal reconstitution is reader-supplied.
The stray, seed-coverer, q-l-l, and r-b-w readings should remain explicitly analogical or exploratory in downstream prose.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Disappearance is mistaken for unrecoverable loss.** `ض ل ل:B002` gives hiddenness, absorption into earth, or burial until no longer visible; `ض ل ل:B003` gives losing or failing to locate something. The extraction from hidden fluid in 32:8 and the complete taking in 32:11 surround the objection with two contrary recovery mechanisms. **Inferred arrow (the speakers’):** loss of human visibility/location -> loss to every agent -> impossibility of re-creation. The question now reads as a scale error: terrestrial disappearance is treated as ontological annihilation.

2. **New creation is renewal after severance.** `ج د د:B004` gives newness after cutting, supported by the cutting branch `ج د د:B003`. The speakers imagine bodies dispersed in earth; 32:11 describes them being taken in full and returned. **Inferred arrow:** severed continuity of the present body -> renewed embodied state rather than production from an untouched starting point. *Khalqin jadīd* acquires the sharper image of reconstitution after a cut.

3. **The denied object is accountable encounter.** `ل ق ي:B004` gives two parties coming face to face, while `ك ف ر:B001` supplies covering and `ك ف ر:B003` supplies covering or rejecting truth. The *bal* correction shifts from a technical question about matter to “meeting their Lord”; 32:11–12 then stage return and presence before the Lord. **Inferred arrow:** covering the prospect of confrontation -> framing that resistance as a material objection. Their unbelief reads less as neutral puzzlement over reassembly and more as concealment of the encounter to which reassembly leads.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 32:11 corrected the speakers' “lost in earth” model with complete receipt, while 32:12 and 32:15 contrasted late certainty with immediate sign-responsive prostration. The surprise was that new creation is not blocked by material dispersal; the operative divide is when encounter becomes trusted and acted upon.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: يستعمله المنطقيون في معنى الحد فيقولون قول الجوهر كذا وقول العرض كذا أي حدهما (mufradat)

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, teknik bağlamda sözün bir şeyin tanımı anlamında kullanılmasını verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sesli bir hitap gelmeden anlamın kişinin içine doğmasını ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasını anlatır. Çerçeve, işitilen konuşmadan ayrılan içe doğan anlam aktarımını doğru yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır; işitilen sözlü hitap değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel içe doğma bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İşitilen bir hitap olmadan, bir anlamın kişinin içine doğması ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözsüz biçimde içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır.
Bu kullanım işitilen hitabı özellikle dışarıda bırakır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

source_details.summary: Tekil aktarım, işitilen hitap olmaksızın içe doğan anlamın söz diye adlandırılmasını verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sesli hitap olmadan kişiye gelen anlamın söz diye adlandırıldığı bağlam için uygundur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الخطاب اللفظي المسموع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: في الإلهام فإن ذلك لم يكن بخطاب ورد عليه بل كان ذلك إلهاما فسماه قولا (mufradat)

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, işitilen hitap olmaksızın içe doğan anlamın söz diye adlandırılmasını verir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değerlendiren kişinin bir şeyi az sayması anlamını tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı seyrekleşme ve yokluğa yaklaşma değerlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kolun çekirdeği güçsüzlük, aşağılık ve düşünme yetisindeki zayıflıktır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda değersizlik azlığın uzantısıdır; komşu kolda ise zayıflık ve aşağılık bağımsız çekirdektir, bu yüzden olağan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel azlıkla en yakın örtüşme, değersizlikle kurulan yan ilişki ve aynı kökteki tepe anlamıyla olası karışma en açıklayıcı üç sınır olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس علو الشيء ولا الجرة ولا الحمل ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القل القليل؛ رماه الله بالقل والذل أي بالقلة والذلة (jamhara)؛ شيء قليل وجمعه قلل؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة؛ قلله في عينه؛ أقل افتقر؛ استقله عده قليلا (sihah)؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة فهو قليل وقلال؛ القل من الرجال الخسيس الدنيء؛ قليلة ولا كثيرة؛ قليلا ما يؤمنون؛ قاللت لفلان؛ تقاللت ما أعطاني (tahdhib)؛ القلة والكثرة يستعملان في الأعداد؛ يكنى بالقلة عن الذلة؛ يكنى بها تارة عن العزة؛ قليل يعبر به عن النفي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan gizlenme ve gözden yitme çekirdeğini verir; toprağa karışıp görünmez olma, bir sıvı içinde eriyip seçilemez hale gelme ve ölüyü gömme bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir. Bu nedenle geçici dal çerçevesi kaynakla uyumludur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gizlenerek, toprağa karışarak ya da başka bir maddenin içinde seçilemez hale gelerek gözden yitmesidir. Ölüyü gömmek, onu görünmez kılan özel bir ettirgen kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, hareketli bir şeyin sahibinden gitmesini ve sabit bir yerin konumuna ulaşamamayı aynı bulamama alanında toplar. Kanın öçsüz kalması ise kaybın sahiplik değil karşılık ve talep bakımından kurulduğu özel, kalıba bağlı bir uzantıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sahibinin elinden çıkması veya kişinin hareketli bir şeyi ya da sabit bir yerin konumunu bulamamasıdır. Özel bir kullanımda öldürülen kişinin kanı öç alınmadan ve karşılık aranmadan kalır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin sahibinden gitmesi ve nerede olduğunun bilinememesi temel yitirme ilişkisidir.
Ev, ibadet yeri veya başka sabit bir yerin konumuna ulaşamamak, nesneyi değil yolu bulamama biçimidir.
Bir işin elden kaçması ve ona erişecek yolun bulunamaması, yitirme ilişkisinin soyut uzantısıdır.
Öldürülen kişinin kanının öç alınmadan kalması, kaybı karşılıksız kalma sonucuna bağlayan özel kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yeri temel anlam olarak verir; nesnelerin yere bakan altı ile hayvan ayağının alt bölümü de buna bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel yer anlamı ile yalnız tamlamalarda beliren alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı anlamları birbirinden ayrılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yer anlamını kapsar; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı anlamlarını ise yalnız belirtilen tamlamalara bağlı yan yüzler olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan, üzerinde yaşadığımız yer küresini belirtir. Belirli tamlamalarda bir şeyin yere bakan altını ve hayvanın tırnağını ya da ayağının alt bölümünü de anlatır.

facets.statement: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yer küresidir.
Bir şeyin yere bakan alt bölümü, belirli bir tamlama içinde bu adla anılır.
Hayvanın tırnağı veya ayağının yere değen alt bölümü için kullanılan özel bir tamlama vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamın merkezinde göğün karşısındaki aşağı yerin bulunduğunu; alt bölüm ve hayvan ayağı kullanımlarının bu mekansal çekirdeğe dayandığını birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: yer ve yere bakan alt bölüm
concept_gloss.applicability: Yer küresi anlamını ve ona bağlı alt bölüm yönelimini birlikte özetleyen en kısa doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aşağıda olma, göğe karşıt konum ve yere bakan alt bölüm ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzerinde yaşanan ve göğün karşısında bulunan yer küresi söz konusu olduğunda doğal karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yumuşak, iyi ve verimli toprağı merkez alır; bitkinin köklenip çoğalması veya biçilecek duruma gelmesi ile oğlağın bu ottan yiyip semirmesi buna bağlı gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Toprağın niteliği çekirdektir; bitkinin gelişmesi ve oğlağın beslenmesi sonuç ya da ilişkili kullanım olarak kalmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, nitelikli toprak anlamını yalnız kanıtlanan tamlamalara; bitki, fidan ve oğlakla ilgili anlamları da kendi kanıtlanmış yapılarına bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Belirtilen yapılarda yumuşak, iyi, verimli ve bol bitki yetiştiren toprağı anlatır. Buna bağlı yapılarda bitkinin toprağa iyice yerleşip çoğalması veya biçilebilir olması, köklü fidan ve yer bitkisini yiyen oğlak; ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında ise semiz oğlak ifade edilir.

facets.statement: Toprak veya çayırlık yumuşak, verimli ve iyi bitki yetiştirir.
Bitki toprağa iyice yerleşir, çoğalır veya biçilecek olgunluğa ulaşır.
Oğlak yer bitkisini yer.
Bir kaynakta ilgili niteleme semiz oğlağı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik kanıt, verimli ve yumuşak toprağı; bu toprakta gelişen bitkiyi ve bitkiden yararlanan oğlağı aynı üretkenlik ilişkisi içinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın toprak niteliğine dayanan çekirdeğini eksiksiz ve doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağın yumuşaklığını, iyiliğini, verimini ve bitki yetiştirme gücünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitkinin toprağa yerleşerek çoğalması anlatılan bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin toprağa yerleşmesi ve gelişerek çoğalması sürecini korur.
error_profile.loses: Toprağın genel niteliğini ve oğlağın bu bitkiyle beslenmesi yüzünü dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın, ona layık ve alçak gönüllü oluşunu; karşılaştırmalı yapıda ise bir işi yapmaya en uygun kişi sayılmasını bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen kişi ve eylem yapılarında geçerlidir; genel bir kök anlamı veya doğrudan ahlaki iyilik adı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bütünüyle belirtilen kişi ve eylem tamlamalarına bağlıdır; yalın biçime bağımsız bir uygunluk anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapılarda bir kişinin iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layık olmasını anlatır; bir kaynak bu niteliği alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir. Karşılaştırmalı kullanımda ise bir işi yapmaya başkalarından daha uygun olmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişi iyiliğe yatkın ve ona layıktır.
Karşılaştırmalı yapıda kişi, belirli bir işi yapmaya grubun en uygun üyesidir.
Bir kaynak bu kişi niteliğini alçak gönüllülükle birlikte verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iyiliğe yatkınlık ve layıklık ile belirli bir eyleme en uygun olma yargısını yapı bağımlı tek bir uygunluk alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişi hakkında kurulan belirtilmiş yapıda dalın temel niteliğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İyiliğe yönelme, uygunluk, layıklık ve olumlu kişilik değerlendirmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluk içinden belirli işi yapmaya en uygun kişi seçildiğinde kullanılır.
